Container.Name: OpenFamily-Client
Container.Overview: Web interface for OpenFamily, a family organizer: shared calendar, tasks and chores with a kids rewards system, shopping lists, meal planning and recipes, family budget, kiosk mode and an optional AI assistant. English and French interface.[br][br] This container is the single entry point you open in the browser. It serves the app and proxies /api and /ws to the OpenFamily-Server container, so everything stays same-origin and works from phones and tablets on your network.[br][br] ONE-TIME SETUP (required, from the Unraid terminal, before first start):[br] [b]mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/openfamily/nginx[/b][br] [b]wget -O /mnt/user/appdata/openfamily/nginx/default.conf.template https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NexaFlowFrance/OpenFamily/main/packaging/unraid/nginx/default.conf.template[/b][br][br] Then set "Server Address" below to the IP:port of the OpenFamily-Server container (e.g. 192.168.1.50:3001). Without the template file the app loads but cannot reach the API.
Container.Requires: The OpenFamily-Server container (and its PostgreSQL database), plus the one-time nginx template download described in the Overview.

Config.Name: Server Address
Config.Description: IP:port where the OpenFamily-Server container is reachable, e.g. 192.168.1.50:3001 (used by the bundled nginx proxy)

Config.Name: Nginx Template Path
Config.Description: Container Path: /etc/nginx/templates (must contain default.conf.template - see Overview)
